transcript.statement: The sustainability of the RollCall system is crucial for minimizing its environmental impact. GRN-01 promotes energy-efficient algorithms, while GRN-02 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient cloud storage. GRN-03 ensures real-time attendance updates are low-energy, and GRN-04 allows for resource-efficient report generation. GRN-05 raises awareness of the carbon footprint, encouraging responsible usage. GRN-06 aligns data retention with sustainable practices, and GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices. Together, these requirements support a sustainable approach to attendance tracking.

transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness dimension is vital for ensuring that student attendance data is secure and private. TRU-01 mandates encryption of data both at rest and in transit to protect sensitive information. TRU-02 implements role-based access control, ensuring only authorized users can access data. TRU-03 provides an audit log for tracking changes, enhancing accountability. TRU-04 ensures students can only view their records after authentication, reinforcing privacy. TRU-05 guarantees data integrity through checksums, while TRU-06 allows reporting of unauthorized access. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to prevent unauthorized access during inactivity, making the system more secure.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is critical for the RollCall system to provide timely and responsive attendance tracking. EFF-01 ensures real-time processing for immediate updates, while EFF-02 supports a scalable system for concurrent users. EFF-03 guarantees prompt report generation, and EFF-04 aligns with historical data retention. EFF-05 allows students quick access to their records, and EFF-06 optimizes resource utilization across classes. EFF-07 enhances user interaction with fast UI response. All these requirements work together to ensure a high-performing system.

transcript.statement: The Responsibility dimension is essential for ensuring that the RollCall system adheres to ethical standards and regulatory compliance. RES-01 ensures GDPR compliance, protecting student data rights. RES-02 promotes transparency in attendance recording, fostering accountability. RES-03 allows students to dispute attendance records, ensuring fairness. RES-04 ensures that attendance reports maintain student anonymity, safeguarding privacy. RES-05 keeps students informed about their attendance status, enhancing communication. RES-06 restricts data access based on roles to protect sensitive information. RES-07 guarantees compliance with educational regulations for historical data retention. Together, these requirements establish a responsible framework for the RollCall system.

transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are paramount in the RollCall system to ensure that attendance data is secure and accurate. SAF-05 provides traceability for attendance modifications, while SAF-06 allows for manual overrides in emergencies. SAF-07 ensures regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities, safeguarding the system's integrity.
